blocks.text: O'zbek tilida niyatni «-moqchi» bilan aytamiz: «Yangi telefon **olmoqchiman**», «Akam shifokor **bo'lmoqchi**». Ingliz tilida bunga **be going to** + V1 to'g'ri keladi: I**'m going to** buy a new phone. Bu shaklning ikkinchi ma'nosi — hozir ko'rinib turgan belgiga qarab bashorat: osmonni qora bulut qoplagan bo'lsa, «Yomg'ir yog'adiganga o'xshaydi» — **It's going to** rain. Ikkala holatda ham kelajak hozirgi holatdan kelib chiqadi: qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan yoki belgi allaqachon ko'rinib turibdi.

items.text: **I'm going to** buy a new phone.
Bekzod **is going to** be a pilot.
Look at those clouds. **It's going to** snow.

blocks.text: Shakli: am / is / are + going to + V1

**be** egaga moslashadi (I am, she is, they are), **going to** o'zgarmaydi, undan keyin esa fe'l **V1** — `-s`, `-ing`, `-ed` siz: she's going to **buy** («buys» emas). Inkor va so'roq oddiy be gaplari kabi: be + **not** (I'm **not** going to ...), so'roqda be egadan oldin (**Are** you going to ...?). Qisqa javob: Yes, I **am**. / No, she **isn't**.

**going to** — gapirishdan **oldin** qaror qilingan ish: men buni o'yladim va qilmoqchiman. Bu reja hali boshqalar bilan kelishilmagan bo'lishi ham mumkin. O'zbekcha «-moqchiman», «-moqchimiz», «-moqchimisiz?» shakllari deyarli doim shu ma'noda. `go` fe'li bilan ikki variant ham to'g'ri: I'm going to **go** to Bukhara = I'm going to Bukhara (ikkinchisi — Present Continuous, qisqaroq va ko'proq ishlatiladi).

items.text: We**'re going to** have a picnic on Sunday.

blocks.text: **going to** va Present Continuous (→ 25-dars) ko'pincha bir-biriga yaqin. Farqi: going to — **niyat** (qaror qildim), Present Continuous — **kelishilgan reja** (vaqt belgilangan, boshqalar biladi). Ko'p hollarda ikkalasi ham to'g'ri bo'ladi.

rows: I**'m going to** see a doctor about my back.
I**'m seeing** Dr Karimova at ten on Monday.
Dushanba kuni soat o'nda doktor Karimovaning **qabuliga boraman**.

blocks.text: **going to** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — hozir ko'rib turgan narsaga qarab kelajakni aytish. Qora bulutlar → It's going to rain. Bola daraxtning ingichka shoxida turibdi → He's going to fall! Bu fikr ichkaridagi taxmin emas, ko'z oldidagi dalil asosida. O'zbekchada bunga «... ga o'xshaydi», «hozir ... -adi!» yoki shunchaki kelasi zamon to'g'ri keladi: «Yiqilib tushadi!»

items.text: Oh no! **I'm going to** be sick.
The ice is very thin — it**'s going to** break.
Quick, the train doors **are going to** close!
items.translation: Tez bo'ling, poyezd eshiklari **yopilay deb turibdi**!

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I going to buy a car.» → **I'm going to buy a car.** (am tushib qolmaydi); «She's going to buys.» / «She's going to buying.» → **She's going to buy.** (going to dan keyin — V1); «I'm going to swimming.» → **I'm going to swim.** yoki **I'm going swimming.**; qora bulutlarni ko'rib turib «It will rain» → **It's going to rain.** (dalil bor — going to); og'zaki nutqdagi «gonna» ni yozma matnda ishlatmang — **going to**.
Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha «**-moqchi**» → **going to**. «... **ga o'xshaydi**» (ko'rinib turibdi) → ham **going to**. Ikkala holatda ham sabab hozir bor: miyadagi qaror yoki ko'z oldidagi belgi.

O'tmishdagi amalga oshmagan niyat — **was / were going to**: I **was going to** call you, but I forgot. — «Sizga qo'ng'iroq **qilmoqchi edim**, lekin esimdan chiqibdi.» O'zbekcha «-moqchi edim» bilan aynan bir xil. Gapirish paytida qabul qilingan qaror uchun esa going to emas, **will** ishlatiladi — 27–28-darslar.

rows: am / is / are + going to + V1
We**'re going to** move to Tashkent.
Am / Is / Are + ega + going to ...?

examples.title: Intentions: **I'm going to** + verb
examples.description: Oldindan qilingan qaror, niyat: am / is / are + **going to** + V1. O'zbekchada: «-moqchiman», «-moqchi».

sentences.text: **I'm going to** learn to drive this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz mashina haydashni **o'rganmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: My sister **is going to** study medicine in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Singlim Toshkentda tibbiyotni **o'qimoqchi**.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** paint the kitchen yellow — we bought the paint yesterday.
sentences.translation: Oshxonani sariq rangga **bo'yamoqchimiz** — bo'yoqni kecha olib keldik.

sentences.text: Aziz has saved some money, and he**'s going to** buy a new laptop.
sentences.translation: Aziz biroz pul yig'di va yangi noutbuk **sotib olmoqchi**.

sentences.text: After the exams, Emma **is going to** travel around Uzbekistan for a month.
sentences.translation: Imtihonlardan keyin Emma bir oy O'zbekiston bo'ylab **sayohat qilmoqchi**.

sentences.text: This year **I'm going to** read at least twenty books.
sentences.translation: Bu yil kamida yigirmata kitob **o'qimoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and Bekzod **are going to** have a big wedding in the autumn.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza va Bekzod kuzda katta to'y **qilmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Tom **is going to** call his grandmother tonight — it's her birthday.
sentences.translation: Tom bugun kechqurun buvisiga **qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi** — bugun uning tug'ilgan kuni.

sentences.text: When I retire, I**'m going to** grow vegetables in my village.
sentences.translation: Nafaqaga chiqqanimda qishlog'imda sabzavot **yetishtirmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: The city **is going to** build a new park where the old factory was.
sentences.translation: Shahar eski zavod o'rnida yangi park **qurmoqchi**.

examples.title: Negative: **I'm not going to** ...
examples.description: Inkor niyat: am / is / are + **not going to** + V1. O'zbekchada: «-moqchi emasman», «-moqchi emas».

sentences.text: **I'm not going to** eat any more cake — I'm on a diet.
sentences.translation: Boshqa tort **yemoqchi emasman** — parhezdaman.

sentences.text: Madina **isn't going to** change her job; she likes her boss.
sentences.translation: Madina ishini **o'zgartirmoqchi emas**, boshlig'i unga yoqadi.

sentences.text: We **aren't going to** buy a car this year — it's too expensive.
sentences.translation: Bu yil mashina **olmoqchi emasmiz** — juda qimmat.

sentences.text: Don't worry, I**'m not going to** tell anyone your secret.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, siringizni hech kimga **aytmoqchi emasman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **isn't going to** play football on Sunday because of his knee.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tizzasi tufayli yakshanba kuni futbol **o'ynamoqchi emas**.

sentences.text: My parents **aren't going to** sell the old house in the village.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam qishloqdagi eski uyni **sotmoqchi emas**.

sentences.text: Sarah **isn't going to** stay in London after university; she wants to work abroad.
sentences.translation: Sara universitetdan keyin Londonda **qolmoqchi emas**, chet elda ishlashni xohlaydi.

sentences.text: I've decided: I**'m not going to** apologise first.
sentences.translation: Qaror qildim: birinchi bo'lib **kechirim so'ramoqchi emasman**.

sentences.text: Our company **isn't going to** open a new office in Samarkand after all.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz baribir Samarqandda yangi ofis **ochmoqchi emas**.

sentences.text: Tonight we **aren't going to** watch TV; we**'re going to** play board games with the kids.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun televizor **ko'rmoqchi emasmiz**, bolalar bilan stol o'yinlari **o'ynamoqchimiz**.

examples.title: Questions: **Are you going to** ...?
examples.description: So'roq: **Are** you **going to** ...? What **are** you **going to** do? Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, he isn't. O'zbekchada: «-moqchimisiz?», «nima qilmoqchisiz?»

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to** apply for that job? — Yes, I am.
sentences.translation: O'sha ishga **ariza bermoqchimisiz**? — Ha.

sentences.text: What **are** you **going to** cook for the guests tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun mehmonlarga nima **pishirmoqchisiz**?

sentences.text: **Is** Aziz **going to** sell his old car? — No, he isn't. He**'s going to** give it to his brother.
sentences.translation: Aziz eski mashinasini **sotmoqchimi**? — Yo'q. Uni ukasiga **bermoqchi**.

sentences.text: Where **are** you **going to** put the new sofa?
sentences.translation: Yangi divanni qayerga **qo'ymoqchisiz**?

sentences.text: How long **are** they **going to** stay in Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Ular Buxoroda qancha **qolmoqchi**?

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to** tell Dad about the broken window?
sentences.translation: Dadamga singan deraza haqida **aytmoqchimisan**?

sentences.text: When **is** Madina **going to** finish her studies?
sentences.translation: Madina o'qishini qachon **tugatmoqchi**?

sentences.text: Who **is going to** pay for all this food?
sentences.translation: Shuncha ovqatning pulini kim **to'lamoqchi**?

sentences.text: Which university **is** your son **going to** apply to?
sentences.translation: O'g'lingiz qaysi universitetga **hujjat topshirmoqchi**?

sentences.text: What **are** we **going to** do with all these old books?
sentences.translation: Shuncha eski kitobni nima **qilmoqchimiz**?

examples.title: Predictions: **It's going to** rain
examples.description: Hozir ko'rinib turgan belgiga qarab bashorat: bulutlar qora — **It's going to rain**. O'zbekchada: «... ga o'xshaydi», «hozir ... -adi!».

sentences.text: Look at those black clouds — **it's going to** rain.
sentences.translation: Anavi qora bulutlarga qarang — yomg'ir **yog'adiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Careful! That glass **is going to** fall off the table.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling! Ana u stakan stoldan **tushib ketadi**.

sentences.text: The bus is very late — we**'re going to** miss the start of the film.
sentences.translation: Avtobus juda kechikyapti — filmning boshidan **qolib ketamiz**.

sentences.text: Emma looks very pale. I think she**'s going to** faint.
sentences.translation: Emmaning rangi juda oqarib ketgan. Menimcha, u **hushidan ketadi**.

sentences.text: There's no traffic on the road, so we**'re going to** arrive early.
sentences.translation: Yo'lda tirbandlik yo'q, shuning uchun erta **yetib boramiz**.

sentences.text: Oh no, the score is 3–0. Our team **is going to** lose again.
sentences.translation: Voy, hisob 3:0. Jamoamiz yana **yutqazadi**.

sentences.text: Madina is studying very hard, so she**'s going to** pass the exam easily.
sentences.translation: Madina juda qattiq o'qiyapti, imtihondan bemalol **o'tadi**.

sentences.text: Watch out! You**'re going to** hit that cyclist!
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling! Anavi velosipedchini **urib yuborasiz**!

sentences.text: It's half past eight and Tom is still in bed — he**'s going to** be late again.
sentences.translation: Soat sakkiz yarim, Tom esa hali to'shakda — u yana **kechikadi**.

sentences.text: The sky is clear and the sun is shining, so tomorrow **is going to** be a hot day.
sentences.translation: Osmon musaffo, quyosh charaqlab turibdi — ertaga havo **issiq bo'ladiganga o'xshaydi**.

examples.title: **going to** (intention) or **-ing** (arrangement)?
examples.description: **going to** — niyat: qaror qilingan, lekin hali kelishilmagan bo'lishi mumkin. Present Continuous — boshqalar bilan kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan reja (→ 25-dars).

sentences.text: **I'm going to** visit my aunt in Andijan sometime this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz bir payt Andijondagi xolamnikiga **bormoqchiman**.

sentences.text: My ticket's booked: I**'m visiting** her on 15 July.
sentences.translation: Chiptam olingan: 15-iyulda uning oldiga **boraman**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is going to** ask Madina to marry him.
sentences.translation: Aziz Madinaga turmush qurishni **taklif qilmoqchi**.

sentences.text: They**'re getting** married on 1 October; the restaurant is already booked.
sentences.translation: Ular 1-oktabrda **turmush qurishadi**; restoran allaqachon band qilingan.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** look for a bigger flat next year.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili kattaroq kvartira **qidirmoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: We**'re seeing** a flat in Chilanzar on Saturday at eleven.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni soat o'n birda Chilonzordagi kvartirani **ko'rgani boramiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah **is going to** start running in the mornings.
sentences.translation: Sara ertalablari yugurishni **boshlamoqchi**.

sentences.text: On Sunday she**'s running** in a charity race in Hyde Park.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni u Xayd-parkdagi xayriya poygasida **yuguradi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is going to** talk to his boss about a pay rise.
sentences.translation: Bekzod boshlig'i bilan maosh oshirish haqida **gaplashmoqchi**.

sentences.text: He**'s meeting** her at three o'clock tomorrow in her office.
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat uchda uning kabinetida u bilan **uchrashadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: plans after school
examples.description: Dialog: ikki bitiruvchi kelajak rejalari haqida gaplashyapti. going to — niyat va bashorat, Present Continuous — kelishilgan reja.

sentences.text: — So, Bekzod, what **are** you **going to** do after school?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Bekzod, maktabdan keyin nima **qilmoqchisan**?

sentences.text: — **I'm going to** study computer science in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: — Toshkentda informatikani **o'qimoqchiman**.

sentences.text: — Great! **Are** you **going to** live with your aunt there?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! U yerda xolangnikida **yashamoqchimisan**?

sentences.text: — No, I'm not. I**'m going to** rent a room with two friends.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q. Ikki do'stim bilan xona **ijaraga olmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: — And you, Dilnoza? **Are** you **going to** be a teacher like your mum?
sentences.translation: — Sen-chi, Dilnoza? Onang kabi o'qituvchi **bo'lmoqchimisan**?

sentences.text: — No way! **I'm going to** work as a translator and travel the world.
sentences.translation: — Yo'g'-e! Tarjimon bo'lib **ishlamoqchiman** va dunyoni **kezmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: — Your English is excellent, so you**'re going to** be very good at it.
sentences.translation: — Ingliz tiling a'lo, bu ishni juda yaxshi **uddalaysan**.

sentences.text: — Thanks! Actually, I**'m flying** to London next month for a summer course.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Aslida, kelasi oy yozgi kursga Londonga **uchaman**.

sentences.text: — Wow! **Is** your family **going to** visit you there?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Oilang seni u yerga ko'rgani **bormoqchimi**?

sentences.text: — Maybe. But look at the time — we**'re going to** miss our bus!
sentences.translation: — Balki. Lekin soatga qara — avtobusdan **qolib ketamiz**!

examples.title: Intention or prediction?
examples.description: **going to** ning ikki ma'nosi aralash: niyat (kimdir nimadir qilmoqchi — «-moqchi») va ko'rinib turgan belgiga qarab bashorat («... ga o'xshaydi»). Har bir gapda qaysi ma'no ekanini aniqlang.

sentences.text: Dad **is going to** repair the roof this weekend.
sentences.translation: Dadam shu dam olish kunlari tomni **ta'mirlamoqchi**.

sentences.text: Look at that ladder — it**'s going to** fall!
sentences.translation: Anavi narvonga qarang — **yiqiladi**!

sentences.text: I've bought some flour because **I'm going to** bake samsa tonight.
sentences.translation: Un sotib oldim, chunki bugun kechqurun somsa **yopmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: The roads are icy, so driving **is going to** be dangerous tonight.
sentences.translation: Yo'llar muzlagan, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun mashina haydash **xavfli bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: My younger brother **is going to** join the army after school.
sentences.translation: Ukam maktabdan keyin armiyaga **bormoqchi**.

sentences.text: Listen to that wind! Tonight **is going to** be really cold.
sentences.translation: Shamol qanday guvillayapti! Bugun tunda juda **sovuq bo'ladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** take the children to the zoo on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni bolalarni hayvonot bog'iga **olib bormoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: Bekzod hasn't studied at all. He**'s going to** fail the test.
sentences.translation: Bekzod umuman o'qimagan. U testdan **o'tolmaydi**.

sentences.text: Madina **is going to** open a small bakery with her sister.
sentences.translation: Madina singlisi bilan kichik novvoyxona **ochmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Your phone battery is almost dead — it**'s going to** switch off any minute.
sentences.translation: Telefoningiz quvvati deyarli tugagan — hozir **o'chib qoladi**.

examples.title: Mixed practice: talking about the future
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: going to (niyat, bashorat), Present Continuous (kelishilgan reja) va Present Simple (jadval) — darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Next year Dilnoza **is going to** learn Korean.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili Dilnoza koreys tilini **o'rganmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Her course **starts** on 3 February, and the lessons are online.
sentences.translation: Uning kursi 3-fevralda **boshlanadi**, darslar onlayn bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to** watch the match tonight? — No, I'm too tired.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun o'yinni **ko'rmoqchimisiz**? — Yo'q, juda charchaganman.

sentences.text: We **aren't going to** have a holiday this year — we're saving for a car.
sentences.translation: Bu yil ta'tilga **chiqmoqchi emasmiz** — mashina uchun pul yig'yapmiz.

sentences.text: James **is meeting** his new boss at nine tomorrow, so he**'s going to** go to bed early tonight.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ertaga soat to'qqizda yangi boshlig'i bilan **uchrashadi**, shuning uchun bugun erta **yotmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Look at that queue — it**'s going to** take hours!
sentences.translation: Anavi navbatga qarang — soatlab **vaqt oladi**!

sentences.text: What time **does** your train **leave**? — At 5.20, and Aziz **is driving** me to the station.
sentences.translation: Poyezdingiz soat nechada **jo'naydi**? — 5:20 da, meni vokzalga Aziz **olib boradi**.

sentences.text: My grandparents **are coming** for Navruz, so Mum **is going to** make sumalak.
sentences.translation: Navro'zga bobom va buvim **kelishyapti**, shuning uchun onam sumalak **qilmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **isn't going to** take the job in Leeds; she's happy where she is.
sentences.translation: Sara Lidsdagi ishni **olmoqchi emas** — hozirgi joyida baxtli.

sentences.text: The game **finishes** at ten, so I**'m not going to** be home before eleven.
sentences.translation: O'yin soat o'nda **tugaydi**, shuning uchun o'n birdan oldin uyda **bo'lmayman**.
